headline: Access Holdings Nine-Month Pre-Tax Profit Rises to N667 Billion
summary: Access Holdings Plc reported a pre-tax profit of N667.36 billion for the nine months ended September 2026, an 8.29% increase from N616.25 billion in the prior-year period, driven by lower impairment charges and higher interest and fee income.
why: Access Holdings is a major financial institution in Nigeria; its earnings report provides key insights into banking sector performance and credit quality in West Africa.

impacts.name: Access Holdings
impacts.why: Higher pre-tax profits and lower impairment charges directly reflect stronger operational performance.
